paper_title: Distilling Empathy from Large Language Models
caption: GPT-4o vs. Fine-tuned LLaMA & Mistral in empathetic responses as judged by Gemini
model_annotation: This nested donut chart represents the "Win rate (%)" of GPT-4o compared to fine-tuned LLaMA and Mistral models in empathetic responses, as indicated by the bold text in the chart's center and the accompanying caption. The visualization consists of two concentric rings containing a total of four slices. Rather than using a separate legend, the chart employs external text labels with exact percentages, which are connected to their respective slices via thin black callout lines. The outer ring comprises a large light blue slice labeled "LLaMA: 80.4%" and a smaller dark blue slice labeled "GPT-4o: 19.6%". The inner ring displays a large beige slice labeled "Mistral: 88.0%" and a smaller dark red slice labeled "GPT-4o: 12.0%". None of the segments are exploded or visually offset, but the chart is arranged so that the proportionally smaller GPT-4o segments in both rings are aligned together in the upper-left quadrant.
